method.cadence: Host timestamp interval between native Profiler.step returns. Complete records steps 1–20 per rank; first interval null because no previous boundary; update 10 includes start-boundary synchronization/observer work and update 20 includes end-boundary device drain. Not independently synchronized device update latency.
method.cadence_statistics: For each corresponding measured step take max(interval across ranks), then median/min/max/spread over ten steps. Also retain per-rank statistics. First-five/last-five means use steps 11–15 versus 16–20; drift=(last5/first5-1)*100. These descriptive values do not replace primary envelope throughput or establish settling.
method.compiler_cache: Each timing has a fresh separate task cache; diagnostics reuse the matching timing cache and are excluded from throughput. Existing start/end observer snapshots only; no cache walks. Covered source stability does not prove all asynchronous compilation or all native DeepGEMM JIT paths absent.
method.component_aggregation: Corresponding-sample max over eight ranks, then median/min/max/spread over ten measured samples after ten warmups; ratios of medians, not paired inferential statistics. All paired variants replay the same captured native inputs, canonical harness initialization rather than exported native weights.
method.copies_and_communication: Included in corresponding integrated spans; standalone magnitude unavailable here. Overlapping scopes are not added.
method.device_compute: Unavailable from unprofiled wall/event timing; separate diagnostic trace analysis required.
method.host_sync_and_gpu_wait: Embedding endpoint synchronization span separately measured, but internal wait remains inside host call; native final drain included; GPU idle/wait attribution unavailable here.
method.host_work: Only embedding mixed host-call span separately measured; native/FFN host work not decomposed.
method.main_valid_tokens: 10*512*4095 = 20966400 globally, from Trainer.ntokens_seen once rather than summed eight times. Does not count auxiliary MTP targets as additional throughput tokens.
method.memory: PyTorch allocated/active/reserved peaks in bytes and GiB (2**30). Native lightweight logging resets peak stats each update; adapter samples before native resets, at window boundaries and intervening update returns, retaining maxima through updates 11–20. All runs use same lifecycle. Reserved peaks retain allocator/init cache. Excludes non-PyTorch device allocations; maxima across ranks need not be simultaneous. Counter deltas are end minus start over the measured window.
method.native_primary_elapsed: Same-host max(all rank end monotonic timestamps) minus min(all rank start timestamps), seconds. CUDA synchronization before start and before end timestamp; no per-update adapter synchronization. Updates 11–20 include all 32 microbatches, forward/backward/SAC, optimizer and active native path, input loading/preparation/transfers, communication and lightweight native logging. Startup/first ten updates excluded; profiling, detailed monitoring, validation, checkpoint saving, numerical capture and snapshots disabled.
method.percentage_convention: latency/memory delta % = 100*(candidate/control-1); throughput delta % = 100*(candidate TPS/control TPS-1). Reduced latency stated as negative delta.
method.physical_tokens: 10*512*4096 = 20971520 physical input/label-storage tokens globally; includes final positions without a main target.
method.throughput: global token count / primary_elapsed_s; per GPU divide global throughput by 8.
